text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I couldn't hold on at the very end...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! A loss is a loss, no matter how 
close!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I, No Reason, shall seize 1st place, no 
matter what means I must employ!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, you who sits on the realm's 
throne! This is an overthrow of the high 
by the low, aaaaaagh!!
choice_data_list: With that spirit, you can win!
Let's keep putting in the effort to win!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Results ride on one's determination! 
And my determination will lose to no one!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come up with a training menu that can whip 
all the Umamusume into shape in one fell 
swoop!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my Tactician, nothing 
escapes you! One cannot easily claim that 
effort always bears fruit, but without 
effort, there is nothing to speak of!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
First, let us begin with a strategy 
meeting! Tonight, we hold a war council 
until dawn!
